## Formian Royal Guard (CR 9)

**XP** 6,400  
 LN Large outsider (extraplanar, lawful)  
 **Init** +8; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., hive mind 50 mi.; Perception +18  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 24, touch 14, flat-footed – (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +10 natural, -1 size)  
 **hp** 168 (12d10+48); fast healing 2  
 **Fort** +8, **Ref** +12, **Will** +11  
 **Immune** cold, poison, petrification; **Resist** electricity 10, fire 10, sonic 10; **SR** 20  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 50 ft.  
 **Melee** sting +17 (2d6+4 plus poison), 2 claws +16 (1d8+4)  
 **Ranged** *+1 returning javelin* +16 (1d8+6)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 12th)  
 
  Constant—detect chaos, detect thoughts (DC 15)  
 At will—charm monster (DC 17), clairaudience/clairvoyance, magic circle against chaos, greater teleport  
 1/day—dictum (DC 20), *[order’s wrath](../../magic/spells/orders-wrath.md)* (DC 17)  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 20, **Dex** 18, **Con** 18, **Int** 16, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 17  
 **Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +18, **CMD** 33 (37 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Capture Alive, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Initiative, Spring Attack, Wind Stance, [Weapon Focus (sting)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; in their place: Weapon Focus (sting).*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +19, Climb +20, Diplomacy +18, Intimidate +18, Knowledge (planes) +18, Perception +18, Sense Motive +18, Stealth +19, Survival +15  
 **Languages** Common, Formian  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Poison (Ex)** Sting—injury; *save* Fort DC 20; *frequenc*y 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect* 1d3 Dex damage; *cure* 2 saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.  
 
  
 

**Ecology**

 
**Organization** solitary, team (2-4) or working group (1 plus 7-18 workers plus 6-11 warriors)  
 **Treasure** standard
